data.datasources.yaml:
apiVersion: 1
datasources:
  - name: Prometheus
    uid: s2t-prometheus
    type: prometheus
    access: proxy
    url: ${PROMETHEUS_URL}
    isDefault: true
    jsonData: {timeInterval: 5s}
data.dashboards.yaml:
apiVersion: 1
providers:
  - name: S2T
    type: file
    updateIntervalSeconds: 10
    options: {path: /var/lib/grafana/dashboards}
